destination: Practical coding-agent and general-assistant capability, retaining Runa identity and governance.

capabilities.title: Conversation and writing
capabilities.scope: Personal conversation and explicitly selected project context.
capabilities.acceptance: Continue a reopened conversation and satisfy new instructions without mixing users or old questions.
capabilities.remainingAfterM1: Searchable history, broader writing quality and supported conversation journeys.
capabilities.note: Family-level coverage is incomplete; historical slice evidence is not full-family acceptance.

capabilities.title: Context, memory and learning
capabilities.scope: Personal/project knowledge; owner-governed learning changes remain distinct.
capabilities.acceptance: Use approved knowledge, exclude revoked material and preserve scope across model changes.
capabilities.remainingAfterM1: Full teach/correct/revoke UX, context compaction and long-task continuity.
capabilities.note: Family-level coverage is incomplete; historical slice evidence is not full-family acceptance.

capabilities.title: Files and visual inputs
capabilities.scope: Explicit attachments and project-authorized files only.
capabilities.acceptance: Extract correct content from supported inputs without executing macros or following unsafe external references.
capabilities.remainingAfterM1: General file upload/parsing, archive safety, document and visual inputs.
capabilities.note: Family-level coverage is incomplete; historical slice evidence is not full-family acceptance.

capabilities.title: Live and source-grounded research
capabilities.scope: Approved sources; later scoped outbound research.
capabilities.acceptance: Produce supported citations, distinguish missing/conflicting evidence and exclude unauthorized sources.
capabilities.remainingAfterM1: Live web search/fetch, freshness and multi-source investigation.
capabilities.note: Family-level coverage is incomplete; historical slice evidence is not full-family acceptance.

capabilities.title: Documents, data and artifacts
capabilities.scope: User-provided data and isolated generated artifacts.

capabilities.remainingAfterM1: Executable analysis and usable document, spreadsheet, slide and chart outputs.
capabilities.note: Family-level coverage is incomplete; historical slice evidence is not full-family acceptance.

capabilities.title: Real software development
capabilities.scope: Disposable M1 projects; later explicitly granted retained project roots.
capabilities.acceptance: Edit a real project, observe failing tests, fix the code and verify actual passing results.

capabilities.note: Family-level coverage is incomplete; historical slice evidence is not full-family acceptance.

capabilities.title: Execution and environments

capabilities.title: Browser and application interaction

capabilities.title: Connected tools and services
